Name: Bea's Summit Beautification
Author: BeazNees
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Redesign of the summit map.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Brand new map for the summit[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Map is slightly bigger than the original, moves warps to compensate
Custom bench to fit the better look (its the same but without the rocky ground) [/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37166]Summit Patches[/url][/size][/color]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
This mod is [i]wholly and undoubtedly[/i] non compatible with any other mods that replace the summit map.
Not SVE compatible, as SVE replaces the summit map. 

I made a custom bench tilesheet to use, so the player can sit down like in the old map. I have added support for several recolor mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley Unofficial [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]Blue Grass Recolor[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]A Wittily Named Recolor[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36292]Yri's Retro Recolor-1.6 Community Patch[/url]

If there are other recolors you would want a patch for, please feel free to request!

[b][size=4]Config[/size][/b]
[b]BenchRecolor[/b]
Default: Vanilla
Options: Off, Auto, Vanilla, Earthy, VPR, Wittily, Starblue, BlueGrassRecolor, YriRetroRecolor

[b][size=4]Translations[/size][/b]
For your convenience, the mod features an i18n file, allowing you to add translations! More info about providing translations for the mod can be found [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations#How_to_translate_a_mod]here[/url].
[list]
[*]You are allowed to publish translations as a separate mod as long as it only contains the i18n file and nothing else[/*]
[*]You have to set the mod file type to a translation. It'll automatically
show up in the translations on the main page this way as well[/*]
[*]You are allowed and encouraged to earn Donation Points for translations[/*]
[*]You have to add my mod as a dependency on your translation mod's page[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you for Pillow for the summit patches mod, making my life much easier.
Thank you to anyone in the Stardew Valley discord servers for any advice they've given me, as well as help with any issues i encountered. You guys are awesome! 💖 [/color]
